run.task: Update the roster from this revised registration CSV, including the new attendee. Clean it with the same rules as before. Hall A is unavailable: close Hall A and move Agents lab to Studio D. Replan against its 8-seat capacity. Keep every existing assignment in unaffected workshops exactly as it was, keep the earliest attendees within the new room capacity, then try affected or new attendees’ preferred available workshop or waitlist them. Import the updated roster, apply the checked complete allocation, and export the operations report.

manifest.description: Create a fresh allocation for all participants in input order. Try first_choice then second_choice, assigning to the first workshop with an open room and remaining capacity; otherwise waitlist the participant. Use runtime room capacities, sharing room capacity across workshops in that room. Closed rooms provide no seats. Unknown choices are unavailable. Reject duplicate participant, room or workshop IDs, missing workshop room references and negative capacities. Account for each participant exactly once. Do not carry forward existing reservations.
manifest.title: Allocate preferred workshops in roster order

manifest.description: Read CSV with headers id,name,email,first_choice,second_choice. Trim all fields and lowercase emails. Drop rows with missing required fields, invalid email (must have exactly one @, nonempty local part and dotted domain, and no whitespace), or choices outside valid_workshop_ids. Retain the first valid row per normalized email in source order; invalid rows do not reserve an email. Preserve other field values and order. Return cleaned CSV with the same five headers, normalized participants, and counts of input, invalid, duplicate and retained rows. Reject missing headers.
manifest.title: Normalize registration CSV

manifest.description: Use participants in roster order, runtime rooms and workshops, existing assignments, and affected_workshop_ids. Preserve every existing assignment of a retained participant in an unaffected workshop exactly; reject if these fixed assignments violate current room availability or capacity. Then retain existing attendees in affected workshops in roster order up to remaining open room capacity. Finally process all unassigned participants in roster order, trying first_choice then second_choice with available capacity, otherwise waitlist. Share capacity across workshops in the same room. Closed rooms have zero capacity. Ignore existing assignments for participants no longer in the roster. Reject duplicate participant, room, workshop or existing-assignment participant IDs, unknown workshops or missing room references, and negative capacities. Output each roster participant exactly once, with assignments and waitlist ordered by roster order. No CSV parsing.
